description: Reads the model the way the Beam to Plate plugin (1.0.6) does and studies every section the chosen beams use, against CIVIL NX's own published properties (/ope/SECTPROP): whether the outline was READ correctly (A/Iyy/Izz vs published) and how far the PLATE model sits from it, the verdict (converts / blocked / not read, with the reason), the plugin's plate-or-solid suggestion with the mesh a solid would need, material slots of composite parts, the model's length/force units, the beams that cannot be converted and why, and an element estimate for the mesh. Choose beams with ONE of elementIds, sections, groups or useCivilSelection (default: every beam). Read-only; on the website it runs as a background job (poll job_status).

acceptSections.description: Section ids to convert although their check failed (the window's 'Convert anyway'). Only with the user's agreement.

calibrate.description: Adjust plate thicknesses so the mesh has the section's own A, centroid, Iyy, Izz: where the shape is idealised (generic), every section, or never.

facets.description: Facets per circle for round sections.

groups.description: Every beam in these structure groups.

includeUncountedStiffeners.description: Also mesh stiffeners CIVIL NX leaves out of the section (the 'C' box unticked).

longSize.description: Mesh size along the member (default 0.5 m), in the model's length unit (b2p_survey reports it).

model.description: convert = plates/solids along the member; slice = a transverse slice of each section meshed in its own plane (beams kept, nothing linked or loaded).

sectionLimit.description: How many section cards to return.

sections.description: Every beam of these section ids.

solidMode.description: auto = each section as the plugin suggests (solid for compact concrete, plates for thin walls); plate; solid.

solidPlates.description: How a solid (concrete) section meshed as PLATES is idealised: grid of plates over the real section; thin plates round the outline; one plate per wall.

transSize.description: Mesh size across the section (default 0.25 m), in the model's length unit (b2p_survey reports it).

useCivilSelection.description: The elements selected in CIVIL NX right now.

name: b2p_survey
title: Beam to Plate — which beams and sections can convert
